subject: Next steps — lock demo cadence and introduce Platform & Security

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — lock demo cadence and introduce Platform & Security

Hi Elena & Stephen,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — really helpful to understand Catalyst AI's latency targets for interactive search and the multi-tenant constraints on your platform. Quick recap and proposed next steps so nothing falls through the cracks: 

Summary (short):
- Goal: 99th pct latency < 250ms for 2k QPS baseline; strong data isolation requirements for PII.
- Priority stakeholders: Platform (infra), Security/Compliance, Procurement.

Proposed next steps:
1) Schedule a 75–90 minute technical demo/deep-dive where Marissa walks through integration patterns (SSO, kv-cache, quantized models) + performance expectations.
2) Loop in Platform & Security from both sides — we’ll introduce Markus (security) and Karthik (procurement) on our end. Please confirm your Platform lead and the security/compliance contact so we can send a short mutual action plan.
3) I’ve attached a 1-page post-call agenda and an initial Mutual Action Plan (sheet) to speed alignment.

Proposed windows (Pacific time):
- Wed Jul 28: 09:00–10:30 PT
- Wed Jul 28: 13:00–14:30 PT
- Thu Jul 29: 11:00–12:30 PT

If none of these work, share a couple of times and we’ll compress. Once we lock a window I’ll send a calendar invite and a brief pre-read (SOC2 summary + integration checklist).

Attachments: Redwood-post-call-agenda.docx, MutualActionPlan-v1.xlsx (see attachments)

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132
